notes: The whole app redrawn for a phone: every list is now cards you can read at arm's length, with the green header and colour scheme carried through all forty screens. Nothing is hidden behind the phone's navigation buttons, forms survive an open keyboard, and dialogs scroll instead of overflowing. On the desktop: a bill's type can no longer be changed after it is written - weight or quantity, and cash or credit, are shown as facts on the edit screen, matching the web app. Several panels pinned to one text size now grow with it, so turning the system font up no longer clips them.
